audit_scope: active /World/Assets direct children plus inactive episode objects and compatibility supports
retention_rule: Keep an asset when a benchmark uses it as a target, support or destination, when episode rendering uses it as semantic context, or when it is part of the room/navigation structure.

inactive_episode_objects.policy: These are retained task targets, task supports, Kitchen payload variants, Task73/Task75 groups, or task-visible semantic distractors. They stay inactive until an episode requests them.

inactive_compatibility_supports.reason: Current pick/place initializers activate this invisible sofa support explicitly.

shared_payload_assets.policy: Family 5 lunchbox tasks reuse the Family 9 salad container; there is no second lunchbox asset.

local_binary_dependencies.git_policy: Track the text wrapper; keep the binary in the deployed House asset pack. A clean code checkout alone is not a complete asset deployment.
